data.one_liner: Create visually stunning Siri-style waveforms in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated Siri-style waveform widgets for Flutter with support for both iOS 7 and iOS 9 styles. Allows customization of properties like amplitude, frequency, speed, and colors using dedicated controllers and options.
use_when: You want to display an animated voice or Siri-style waveform in your Flutter app.
You need customizable waveform animations inspired by iOS 7 or iOS 9.
avoid_when: You need standard charts, graphs, or data visualizations rather than animated waveforms.
strengths: Easy to set up with predefined iOS 7 and iOS 9 styles.
Supports live property updates via controllers (amplitude, color, speed, frequency).
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused solely on Siri-style waveforms.
